cards.verse_text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
cards.snippet: …he begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”

cards.card_text: The angel says something will be fulfilled when the seventh angel begins to sound his trumpet.
cards.verse_text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
cards.snippet: …he begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”

cards.card_text: So the ten kings and the beast may look like they're in charge, but the angel says it's God's purpose they're carrying out, until the words of God are fulfilled.
cards.verse_text: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
cards.snippet: …give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
